highlights.description: A framework-neutral format for assessment records: evidence manifests, a scope of providers, shared platforms and products, control implementation records, and crosswalks
Several separately marketed products on one shared platform: a platform control is recorded once and inherited by each product, and each product gets its own assessment
Per-product, per-audience views and resolutions that withhold anything naming another product, with the reason, so public and NDA outputs cannot disclose the others
`assessment` CLI and an OSCAL component definition export

added.description: `evidence` package: the evidence manifest, its validation, set loading and SHA-256 verification
Evidence freshness per tool, by artifact age and vulnerability-database age, with ages written as duration strings
`mentions` distinguishes an artifact that names no system (`[]`) from one whose collector declared nothing (absent)
`audience` package: public, NDA and internal, ordered
`scope` package: organization, providers, shared platforms, systems and components, with validation
Per-system evidence views for each audience, withholding artifacts that name other systems or whose mentions are undeclared
System markers, mention detection in any text, and a check for artifacts naming systems their manifests omit
`controls` package: implementation records with status, origination, inheritance, prose, evidence, findings, attestations and visibility
Control resolution: a system's effective status for a baseline plus its added controls, with the contributing records, the weakest verification, and audience-filtered prose, evidence and findings
`crosswalk` package: criterion identifiers mapped to control IDs with source and licence, and a system's coverage of a framework
`schema` package: generated, embedded schemas for the evidence manifest, scope, controls and crosswalk
`oscal` module: an OSCAL 1.2.3 component definition per system and audience, with stable UUIDs and effective status for inherited and hybrid records

tests.description: Example organization with two products on one platform, and golden views, resolutions, coverage and OSCAL exports for each
OSCAL exports validated against the OSCAL schema
CLI output checked against the golden files

documentation.description: Adoption guides for collectors and engines
Walkthrough of two products on one platform
